summary: The bad() method seeds the salt from java.util.Random, whose output is predictable, making the one-way hash vulnerable (CWE-760). Switched the salt source to SecureRandom (already imported) so the salt is cryptographically unpredictable while preserving the hashing feature.

edits.old:
Random random = new Random();
            MessageDigest hash = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-512");
edits.new:
SecureRandom random = new SecureRandom();
            MessageDigest hash = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-512");
